answer: The saffron counter is kept in ripple and nectar shows each reset. An attacker therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 15 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 15 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Each duplicate costs another 70 dollars in locked collateral and another 1 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
